description: Build a complete second brain application with notes, tasks, links, daily views, authentication, and a comprehensive agent management system

parameters.name: dashboard_url
parameters.description: The reference dashboard URL to clone

parameters.name: deployment_platform
parameters.description: Platform to deploy the application to

parameters.name: agent_count

steps.description: Build the core second brain app with notes, tasks, links, daily views, and authentication
Add AI-powered note summarization, advanced search, and productivity tool integrations
Implement the ETHINX agent system with external data access management
Build agent registry with permissions, status tracking, and failure monitoring
Create comprehensive agent management interface with toggles, permissions, and activity logs

Implement internal agents for Strategy, Content, and Copy generation
Build secure agent management interface showing only external-access agents
